method: Blind second pass: frames re-extracted with ffmpeg select=eq(n,IDX) (absolute CFR index) from source recording dvids-967848 (datasets/corpus/media/dvids-967848-aba9629c681d.mp4, sha256 aba9629c681d159e0560583865085b8bcceaaa850f9d81f5b26832a86fc90e3c, 29.97fps). Clip frame n maps to source frame n+779 (registry declares rally1 = indoor 26.0-30.4s; 26.0*29.97=779.2; phash-style visual align of clip f0 against source frames 778-782 confirmed ~779-780). Contact re-derived from direct frame inspection (ball-at-paddle adjacency or ball direction reversal) without reading prior contact values; prior event times were used only to locate which events to audit. Audit contact = midpoint of the smallest visually defensible source-frame window. Prior values compared only after the blind pass.

auditRecords.note: Ball adjacent to target's raised paddle at n9, occluded/struck by n10; window n9-10, midpoint 317ms. Matches prior exactly.

DISPUTE. Full-frame sequence n33-n37: ball left of net post at n33, crosses toward target n34-n35, at target's paddle (low) at n36, back left of the net by n37 (direction reversal). Audit window n36-37 (1201-1235ms) does not overlap prior bracket 1083/1150ms (n32.5-34.5). Prior value not edited; filed as finding.
Ball visibly at target's paddle face at n44, departing left by n45-n46. Window n44-45, midpoint 1485ms. Agrees with prior.

DISPUTE (no contact observed). Pixel-track of the ball across n44-n58: after the n44-45 contact the ball travels left continuously (x approx 548@n48 -> 445@n49 -> 338@n50 -> 225@n51 -> 107@n52) and is descending near the net roughly 900px from the target at the prior contact time n51.5; no paddle is near the ball and no direction change occurs until the partner's dig at n57-n59. The prior dig #3 label at 1717ms is not supported by the frames; possibly a double-count of the n44-45 contact. Prior value not edited; filed as finding.

Partner (black shirt, pink paddle) lunges low; ball last inbound at n57 (752,717), occluded/at paddle n58, first seen departing left-up at n59 (615,602) and continues (545,548)@n60 -> (467,495)@n61. Reversal window n57-59, midpoint n58 = 1935ms. Agrees with prior.

Ball inbound right-down (435,369)@n80 -> (806,605)@n86, reaches target's paddle at n86, outbound left-up (748,568)@n87 -> (129,384)@n94. Reversal window n86-87, midpoint 2886ms. Prior 2900 (n86.9) falls inside the audit window.

DISPUTE (not observable). The source video cuts to a different camera angle between n115 and n116 (prior contact time is exactly n116.0). Pre-cut frames n113-n115 show a large motion-blurred ball entering top-left moving right (incoming lob), with no contact; post-cut frames show a different framing with a ball already in flight (433,435)@n116 -> (551,354)@n121. No contact is observable at the prior time from either side of the cut. Also note: registry describes rally1 as a single continuous shot, but a cut exists at clip ~3.85s. Prior value not edited; filed as finding.
